description: This Java class 'TransactionUtil' provides utility methods for managing transactions within the OFBiz framework, including starting, committing, rolling back, suspending, resuming transactions, and managing transaction-related metadata such as timestamps and suspension stacks.

classes.name: TransactionUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing transaction management functions such as begin, commit, rollback, suspend, resume, and resource enlistment within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.NoTransaction
classes.description: Inner class implementing Callable to execute code outside of a transaction, suspending and resuming transactions as needed.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.InTransaction
classes.description: Inner class implementing Callable to execute code within a transaction, handling begin, commit, and rollback automatically.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.StampClearSync
classes.description: Synchronization class to clear transaction timestamp stamps after transaction completion.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.RollbackOnlyCause
classes.description: Class representing the cause for marking a transaction as rollback-only, including message and throwable.

methods.name: doNewTransaction
methods.description: Executes a Callable within a new transaction context, handling exceptions.

methods.name: doTransaction
methods.description: Executes a Callable within an existing transaction context.

methods.name: noTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to execute outside of a transaction, suspending any active transaction.

methods.name: inTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to execute within a transaction, managing begin and commit/rollback.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a transaction if none is active, considering transaction status and rollback flags.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if active.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if active.

methods.name: setRollbackOnly
methods.description: Marks the current transaction as rollback-only with a cause message and throwable.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the current transaction, saving its state.

methods.name: enlistConnection
methods.description: Enlists an XAConnection in the current transaction and returns a JDBC Connection.

methods.name: enlistResource
methods.description: Enlists an XAResource in the current transaction if active.

methods.name: getTransactionStateString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a given transaction status code.

methods.name: registerSynchronization
methods.description: Registers a Synchronization callback with the current transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionStartStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the current transaction started, registering a synchronization if needed.

methods.name: getTransactionUniqueNowStamp
methods.description: Returns a unique timestamp for the current transaction, ensuring no overlaps.
